summary: The earliest source gap in this recording is eat.c:cprefx() on the tin-consumption path, despite the cpostfx wording in the case title. C opens the blessed homemade tin, asks whether to eat its human-wererat contents, then consume_tin() calls cprefx() before cpostfx(). cprefx() calls maybe_cannibal(pm, TRUE); the recorded human Wizard is not allowed to eat its own human species, so C prints “You cannibal! You will regret this!” and consumes rn2(4)=1 in change_luck. JS currently records note_unported("eat.c cprefx") in consume_tin(), skipping that earlier message, state change, and draw. The evaluation later stops in JS newuhs() after consuming the tin: C tintxts[9] supplies Szechuan nutrition 70 and greasy 0, but JS TIN_VARIETIES[9] lacks both fields; its undefined nutrition makes lesshungry() turn u.uhunger into NaN, which hungerStatus() classifies as FAINTING and exposes through the current newuhs() stop marker. This is a missing table-data effect, not an independently exercised C fainting transition. The genuine later lycanthropy/equipment gaps in cpostfx() remain; a separate newuhs() fainting/starvation port applies only if a valid numeric hunger transition independently reaches that C branch. The actionable source task is a whole-function file-port of eat.c:cprefx() and its production caller wiring.

source.branch: The Wizard uses #eat on a blessed homemade tin of human wererat meat, passes the opening prompt, and answers yes to “Eat it?”. The opening roll rn2(2)=1 takes start_tin() through the opentin() occupation to consume_tin(); the variety roll rn2(15)=9 selects tintxts[9], szechuan. C calls cprefx(PM_HUMAN_WERERAT) before cpostfx(); cprefx() calls maybe_cannibal(pm, TRUE), and the recording confirms its own-species branch through the message and rn2(4)=1. C later reads tintxts[9].nut=70 and tintxts[9].greasy=0. JS lacks those fields in TIN_VARIETIES[9], so nutrition is undefined and the saved stop follows NaN hunger state rather than a valid C fainting transition.
callers: C eat.c:consume_tin() (1610-1613) calls cprefx(mnum), then cpostfx(mnum) if the tin remains. For this case consume_tin() is reached through eat.c:start_tin() and opentin() (1703-1718) after the blessed-tin delay. JS eat.js:consume_tin() (1158-1162) currently records note_unported("eat.c cprefx") at this exact call site.

The production command path is cmd.c #eat -> eat.c:doeat() tin arm (2953-2959) -> start_tin() (1723-1796); JS cmd.js:runEatCommand() (3233-3239) -> eat.js:doeat() -> start_tin() (4203-4208) -> opentin() (1243-1258) -> consume_tin().

C also calls cprefx() from eat.c:start_eating() (2041) for corpse meals; JS eat.js:start_eating() (3357) already calls its cprefx helper on that route. Preserve that caller while wiring the missing tin route.
dependencies: cprefx() is void. It calls maybe_cannibal(pm, TRUE) and discards the boolean result, but the message, luck change, aggravation state, and rn1(4, 2) draw are required. JS already has maybe_cannibal() at eat.js:2153-2189; consume_tin() skips it by skipping cprefx().

The whole cprefx() body consumes return values from flesh_petrifies(), poly_when_stoned(), polymon(), revive_corpse(), and acidic() in branch conditions. Existing JS counterparts are in mondata.js, polyself.js, do.js, and eat.js; the current cprefx helper still has explicit UnsupportedEatError arms for some source branches, so the file-port scope must account for the full C function and any return-dependent callee that remains unported.

The later stop has a separate, concrete table-data cause: C eat.c tintxts[9] is {"szechuan", 70, 1, 0}, while JS eat.js TIN_VARIETIES[9] defines only name and healthFood. consume_tin() reads nutrition and passes undefined to lesshungry(); lesshungry() adds it to u.uhunger, producing NaN, and hungerStatus(NaN) falls through to FAINTING before the saved newuhs() refusal. The missing greasy field is part of the same incomplete table mapping; for this selected variety C greasy=0, so it is not itself the NaN cause or an exercised slippery-fingers effect.

The recorded PM_HUMAN_WERERAT path also has genuine later JS void gaps: cpostfx() records note_unported("were.c set_ulycn") and note_unported("artifact.c retouch_equipment"). These are downstream effects, independent of the NaN table-data stop. A separate newuhs() fainting/starvation port is conditional on another trace reaching that C transition branch with valid numeric hunger; this recording does not independently exercise it.
